officialDocsValidated.summary: Docs confirm: allow = exit 0 + no output; deny = exit 0 + JSON {hookSpecificOutput:{permissionDecision:'deny'}}. Env is inherited from parent process (CAM_SESSION visible to hook). agent_type is top-level in the payload (not in tool_input) when hook fires inside a subagent. Three-path defensive read (tool_input.subagent_type // tool_input.agent_type // agent_type) is consistent with this.
